title: Count Number of Ways to Place Houses
summary: Given a street with n plots on each side, calculate the number of ways to place houses such that no two houses are adjacent on the same side, modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Given a street with n plots on each side, calculate the number of ways to place houses such that no two houses are adjacent on the same side, modulo 10^9 + 7. Houses can be placed on both sides of the street independently.
constraints: There are n plots on each of two independent street sides.
No two houses on the same side may occupy adjacent plots.
reference_solution:
def count_house_placements(n):
    empty=1;occupied=0
    for _ in range(n):empty,occupied=(empty+occupied)%1000000007,empty
    return (empty+occupied)**2%1000000007

hints: First count valid layouts for one side.
Track counts ending with an empty plot and with an occupied plot.
The next empty plot follows either state; the next occupied plot follows only empty. Square the final one-side total.
The two street sides are independent, so the product of their identical counts includes every paired layout exactly once.

tests.explanation: Each side may be empty or occupied, giving four paired layouts.
One side has three valid patterns, so two sides have nine paired layouts.
